Iron pills only absorb 10 to 15%. The rest just passes through you. I tracked my ferritin for 18 months. Ferrosisulfate, bisglycinate, floridax, thorn. My number went from 11 to 13 in a year and a half. Here's the part nobody told me. Your gut has a fixed number of DMT1 receptors. They're the doors that let iron into your bloodstream.
